text: Kaa a yi*aali -an Nulaaɗo- wonndema Alla O jippinii immorde ka kammu toɓo, leydi ndin wattini ɓaawo jippagol toɓo ngon e mayri haakiɗundi sabu ko ndi funni kon immorde e puɗi, pellet Alla ko O Newaniiɗo jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen nokku ka O jippinani ɓe toɓo ngon, O fuɗinani ɓe leydi ndin, ko O Humpitiiɗo nafaaji maɓɓe ɗin, suuɗanaaki hay e huunde e ɗum.
